scope: Actual pinned BOTSORT CPU compatibility smoke on first 200 sequential retained TOR3-PAGI detector rows. No YOLO model loading/inference; no full-video tracking/quality claim. img=None because ReID and GMC explicitly disabled.

tracker.update_signature: (self, results, img: 'np.ndarray | None' = None, feats: 'np.ndarray | None' = None, **kwargs) -> 'np.ndarray'

override_provenance.gmc_method: PROPOSAL: none disables compensation for controlled Phase3 baseline; no shake correction capability/need decision
override_provenance.with_reid: REQUIREMENT: disabled in Phase3 baseline; ReID implementation/experiments are Phase4

tracker.frame_id_semantics: 1-based update-call count, equals 0-based cached video frame_index+1
tracker.track_id_scope: one tracker instance, reset on new video; not physical object proof

limitations: Only first 200 real rows processed in this compatibility test.
Source detector uses published conf=0.25 baseline; retained cache does not provide the complete lower-score (0.1,0.25) observation range used by the standard BoT-SORT second association.
No actual image/physical identity review performed by this smoke.
No ID-switch, fragmentation, accuracy, tracking metric or counting claim.
Other scenes, night, ReID, GMC and tuned thresholds remain untested.
